metadataRaw.title: How to Self Adjust Your Big Toe
metadataRaw.description:
Does your big toe feel locked up, misaligned, or it's just giving off pop or crack sounds?

In this video, Dr. Rowe shows how to self adjust your big toe for INSTANT RELIEF.

These self mobilization exercises can be done at home, are DIY, and require only your hands and a big toe.

They may help reset the big toe into better alignment, relieving tension and stiffness in (and around) the joints of the 1st digit and metatarsal. 

This should help you have improved movement in the big toe, less tightness and dull, achy pain, and less of those pop and crack sounds.

So if you're in need of an stiff, achy big toe fix -- WATCH now and get feeling better!
